scope: Local image builds and uncommitted source integration; no publication or deployment

registry.public_recompile_dependency: Rebrew 6.0.4 unchanged; source checks use PYTHONPATH=../rebrew/src

smoke.source:
int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
 (Delphi uses the existing t.dpr fixture)
smoke.method: Docker --pull=never; only recorded timestamp metadata masked; expected hashes match on both runs

parity.method: Compare initialized section contents, relocations and NOBITS sizes; no bytes are read from NOBITS sections

checks.rebrew_targeted_command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_compile.py tests/test_toolchain.py tests/test_parsers_elf.py tests/test_parsers_relocs_full.py tests/test_gen_flirt_pat.py

limits.relocation_matching: MOS and unknown/non-32-bit I386/M68K relocations fail closed; native ASxxxx/xo65/Z80RMF/ACK/Hunk readers remain unavailable
limits.msvc_12_cpp: Qualified with Wine; Wibo 1.2.0 lacks native MSVCP120 RtlCreateUnicodeString support
limits.daze: The previously measured large-input software-backend performance limit remains
limits.saturn: Native32/native64 match; GNU assembler trailing NOPs can differ from the original DOS assembler
limits.licenses: SHC converter gists have no verified declared licence; VBCC components retain restrictive original terms
limits.downloads: PPA retention and mutable upstream tag URLs can break future cold fetches; SHA-256 pins prevent silently accepting changed bytes

migration_verification.method: Exact fingerprints admit reviewed pipeline/access repairs; archive numeric owners do not alter compiler contents

release_integration.rootless_archive_fixes: Preserved newer main ownership safeguards, including VBCC nested archives and devkitPro packages
